# Test pe mod commands - dependency management like go mod

# Initialize module
pe mod init github.com/myorg/myproject
stdout 'go: creating new pe.mod'
exists pe.mod
contains pe.mod 'module github.com/myorg/myproject'
contains pe.mod 'pe 1.0'

# Add a dependency
pe mod get github.com/anthropic/helpful-harmless@latest
stdout 'go: downloading github.com/anthropic/helpful-harmless v1.2.0'
stdout 'go: added github.com/anthropic/helpful-harmless v1.2.0'
exists pe.sum
contains pe.mod 'require'
contains pe.mod 'github.com/anthropic/helpful-harmless v1.2.0'

# List dependencies
pe mod list
stdout 'github.com/myorg/myproject'

pe mod list -m all
stdout 'github.com/anthropic/helpful-harmless v1.2.0'
stdout 'github.com/openai/best-practices v2.1.0'

# Update dependencies
pe mod get -u
stdout 'go: upgraded github.com/anthropic/helpful-harmless v1.2.0 => v1.3.0'

# Tidy dependencies
pe mod tidy
stdout 'go: downloading github.com/google/tech-writing v1.0.0'
! stderr .

# Vendor dependencies
pe mod vendor
stdout 'go: copying requirements'
exists vendor/
exists vendor/github.com/anthropic/helpful-harmless/
exists vendor/modules.txt

# Graph dependencies
pe mod graph
stdout 'github.com/myorg/myproject github.com/anthropic/helpful-harmless@v1.3.0'
stdout 'github.com/anthropic/helpful-harmless@v1.3.0 github.com/openai/best-practices@v2.1.0'

# Download specific version
pe mod download github.com/google/tech-writing@v1.0.0
stdout 'go: downloading github.com/google/tech-writing v1.0.0'
exists .pe/mod/cache/download/github.com/google/tech-writing/@v/v1.0.0.info

# Replace directive
pe mod edit -replace github.com/openai/best-practices=./local-overrides/best-practices
contains pe.mod 'replace github.com/openai/best-practices => ./local-overrides/best-practices'

# Module verification
pe mod verify
stdout 'all modules verified'

# Why query
pe mod why github.com/openai/best-practices
stdout '# github.com/openai/best-practices'
stdout 'github.com/myorg/myproject'
stdout 'github.com/anthropic/helpful-harmless@v1.3.0'
stdout 'github.com/openai/best-practices@v2.1.0'

# Clean module cache
pe mod clean -modcache
stdout 'removed module download cache'
! exists .pe/mod/cache

-- pe.mod --
module github.com/myorg/myproject

pe 1.0

-- prompt.txt --
Apply best practices from helpful-harmless framework

-- go.mod --
// This should not interfere with pe.mod
module example.com/different

go 1.21
